title: The Pun That Escaped
text:
A pun works by exploiting two meanings of a single word, so that the listener hears both at once. Its humour depends on a brief collision between the expected sense and the unexpected one. Because the effect is so quick, many puns are dismissed as trivial, although they reveal a great deal about how meaning is stored and accessed.

Writers have long used double meaning for more serious purposes, embedding a second sense that only attentive readers will catch. Such ambiguity can deepen a character's irony or reveal a hidden judgement. The reader who notices the wordplay therefore becomes a collaborator in the text rather than a passive recipient of it.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does a pun exploit?
options: Two meanings of a single word
Two different languages spoken at once

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can double meaning reveal?
options: Only the plot of a story

questions.text: Why are puns often dismissed as trivial, according to the passage?
options: Because they are too long to remember
Because the effect is quick, although they reveal how meaning is stored
Because readers always understand them immediately

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about a reader who notices wordplay?
options: They become a collaborator in the text
They lose interest in the story
They can no longer read the text clearly
They must rewrite the author's words

vocabulary.definition: making use of something to gain an advantage or effect
a contrast between what is said and what is meant
the quality of allowing more than one interpretation
a person who works with others to create something

paragraph_translations: Каламбур спирається на два значення одного слова, тож слухач чує обидва одночасно. Його гумор ґрунтується на короткому зіткненні очікуваного і несподіваного сенсу. Оскільки ефект такий швидкий, багато каламбурів вважають дрібницею, хоча вони багато розповідають про те, як значення зберігається і відтворюється в пам'яті.

Письменники давно використовують подвійне значення для серйозніших цілей, вбудовуючи другий зміст, який помітять лише уважні читачі. Така неоднозначність може поглибити іронію персонажа або виявити приховану оцінку. Читач, який помічає гру слів, тому стає співавтором тексту, а не пасивним його сприймачем.
